## Selling points

1. **#1 on centrality + accessibility** (score 93.2/100); wins 8,615 of 10,000 random weightings.
2. **Lowest total cost of attendance: $18.86M** (#1 of viable cities), $0.66M below runner-up St. Louis, MO.
3. **Time is the real cost:** 81.6% of cost is lost billable time; Chicago saves 4,010 person-hours ($1.56M) vs Houston, the cheapest on cash alone.
4. **Largest office (299 local attendees)**; every other office except New Bern (2 people) reaches Chicago by nonstop flight or a ≤150-mile drive.
5. **Largest US convention center** with room for everyone in one general session.

Cost breakdown: airfare & mileage $1.28M, hotel $2.20M, lost billable time $15.38M.
